title: Check Out our 39 Bluestem Street WaterColor Home Rental | Dune Vacation Rentals – Dune Vacation Rentals
meta_description: This beautiful, 4-bedroom WaterColor home rental is tucked away, offering its guests the privacy and relaxation they need. Enjoy comfort and convenience. Book here!
description_expanded:
Barkin on 30A | Lake District, Watercolor, FL

39 Bluestem Lane, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Tucked away in the Lake District of the beautiful community of Watercolor sits Barkin on 30A | 39 Bluestem. This cozy cottage is perfectly situated from the Sandhill Pool or a short walk to Camp Watercolor. This residence offers 4 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and is dog friendly (see restrictions in home highlights)!

This residence greets you with an open concept first floor to allow for plenty of room for the whole family. The kitchen offers stainless steel appliances, bar stool seating for 6 guests, and the dining table can accommodate 8 guests. Just off of the kitchen is access to the screened-in porch which is the perfect place to relax. The porch offers al-fresco dining or comfortable seating. The master bedroom is located on the first floor with a king sized bed and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower. There is also a half bathroom and laundry room on the first floor.

The second floor features an additional king bedroom with a private bathroom with a luxurious walk-in shower. Next you will find an open space for watching tv and one bunk bed with twin over twin sized mattresses. There are two bedrooms each with two single beds, his and her bedrooms. One bedroom has a private bathroom and the other shares the hall bathroom.

Need a little more room? Dune also manages a 5-bedroom home that is two doors down; Blue Skies | 17 Bluestem Lane

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

First Floor

- Open concept main living and dining space

- Spacious kitchen with stainless steel, bar stool seating for 6 guests, and dining table seating for 8 guest

- Master bedroom with a king sized bed and private bathroom with a walk-in shower

- Screened-in porch with dining and seating

- Half bathroom

- Laundry room

Second Floor

- Guest bedroom with king sized bed and private bathroom with a walk-in shower

- Guest bedroom with two twin single beds and a private bathroom

- Guest bedroom with two twin single beds and shared hallway bathroom

- Open space with a comfortable sofa, tv, and twin over twin bunk bed

Outdoor Space

- Dining tables for alfresco dining

- Grill

- Outdoor shower

- Outdoor fireplace

- Parking for 2 vehicles

- 4 beach cruiser bicycles

Additional

- Guests can enjoy complimentary rides anywhere in WaterColor using the on-demand WaterColor Trolley, available through the WaterColor Trolley app in your app store.

- Dog Friendly: Max weight of the dog is 40lbs. You must notify us of the breed and weight of dog. Pet cleaning fee of $250 applies

- Parking for 2 vehicles.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- WaterColor HOA allows one golf cart per address- you may not rent a second cart if the home you have rented offers one. All golf cart rentals in Watercolor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to a specific amount throughout the community at any given time. Cart rentals are granted on a first-come, first-served based. Watercolor condos cannot rent golf carts.

- 10 Amenity Wristbands - Maximum. Extras are not available. Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club.

- The HOA issues one parking pass per reservation. Guests are encouraged to park their vehicles in the driveway or garage of their rental home. They do not need a parking pass when their vehicle is parked on a private residential property.The HOA-issued parking pass is required to park a vehicle overnight on the common area parking pads.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
